description: This file defines the interface for a PKI (Public Key Infrastructure) implementation, including functions for generating key pairs, certificate requests, self-signed certificates, and supporting cryptographic operations. It mainly contains function declarations and macro guards related to PKI entity creation and management.

methods.name: GenerateAttrByCertificate
methods.description: Generates certificate attributes based on the provided ASN.1 certificate structure.

methods.name: AnscCreatePKIEntity
methods.description: Creates a PKI entity responsible for generating key pairs, certificate requests, and self-signed certificates.

methods.name: AnscCreatePKIEntityWithCryptoAPI
methods.description: Creates a PKI entity with cryptographic API support, useful for smartcard or hardware security module integration.

methods.name: AnscCreatePKIEntityWithCert
methods.description: Creates a PKI entity with a ready certificate and private key encoding, without generating new requests.

methods.name: AnscCreatePKIEntityWithKeyPair
methods.description: Creates a PKI entity with an existing key pair, but no certificate yet.

methods.name: PKIEntityRemove
methods.description: Frees memory and destroys the PKI entity.
